typeHelp: Choose the status that accurately describes how you sell. This is shown to buyers and applies to future listings and orders.
professionalHelp: I sell as part of my professional or business activity.
privateHelp: I sell personally, outside any professional or business activity.
ifApplicable: If applicable in your country or to your status.
privateBuyerNotice: This is a private seller. EU consumer protections that apply specifically to trader-to-consumer contracts may not apply in the same way; other contractual and legal rights may still apply.
professionalBuyerNotice: This seller declares that they act professionally. Applicable consumer rights remain available.
checkoutBlocked: This seller must confirm their legal seller status before checkout can continue.
legalStatusNote: Todijo requires sellers to declare whether they act professionally or privately and shows that declaration before purchase. This is seller-declared status, not a Todijo identity-verification badge. Applicable consumer rights depend on the seller's legal status and the circumstances.
